ReleaseNotes: SnipEX 2.2.16 adds a theme choice in Preferences, including the new Hallow's Eve theme with pumpkin-orange accents, and fixes several reliability issues: a snippet saved during a private library sync can no longer be reverted, background refreshes no longer overwrite text being typed, unexpected errors no longer close SnipEX, reopening from the taskbar brings the window to the front, and an unreadable settings file no longer resets your preferences. Existing snippets, synchronized libraries, preferences, and sign-in state are preserved. Startup updates require approval; per-user installation needs no administrator elevation. This employee-testing release remains unsigned.
